normalized_matching_profile.description: Description 30A ESCAPES presents “Emerald Escape,” your ultimate getaway in Seacrest Beach! This stunning 5-suite retreat sits right across from the 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool and offers everything you need for a memorable vacation. Cruise the charming streets on one of 7 Bikes, relax on sugar-white sands just 5-min walk away, or enjoy boutique shopping and dining at your fingertips. Even your furry friend can join the fun!*** HIGHLIGHTS *** Beautiful Outdoor Living Space with Gas Grill: The perfect spot for BBQs, stargazing, alfresco dining, or simply relaxing and unwinding. Pet-Friendly: A perfect, pet-friendly home for the entire family! Seasonal Tram Service to Beach Access: Enjoy easy transportation to the beach for carefree days by the water which is just 5-min walk away. 2-Minute Bike Ride to Boutique Shopping and Dining: Enjoy quick and easy access to local shops and delicious restaurants. 7 Beach Cruiser Bikes: Explore the scenic paths of 30A and coastal charm at your own pace. Steps from Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach: Boutique shopping, dining, and stunning white sand beaches are all nearby.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "The location is unbeatable—close to the beach, pool, and great restaurants. Perfect for families!" – John R. "The house fit our family perfectly, and the kids loved the Lagoon Pool and outdoor space!" – Gina C. "Spacious, clean, and in an amazing spot. We would definitely return!" – Jill F.*** LIVING AREA ***Enter a bright, open-concept living space where natural light pours in, highlighting the inviting, cozy furnishings. The first floor features plush seating and a large Smart TV, ideal for relaxing movie nights. French doors open to a tranquil patio with stunning views of the Lagoon Pool, offering the perfect retreat. Open-concept living space with modern furnishings Comfortable seating and large Smart TV Patio access with pool views*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The newly remodeled kitchen is an entertainer's dream, boasting premium appliances, sleek granite countertops, and a chic dining area, complemented by additional bar seating for a casual touch. Modern kitchen with stainless-steel appliances Granite countertops and tiled backsplash Dining table seats 6, plus extra bar seating for 4*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Step outside and enjoy multiple inviting outdoor spaces designed to embrace the relaxed coastal lifestyle of Seacrest Beach. Sip morning coffee on the balcony, gather for dinner with lagoon pool views or unwind in the fresh coastal air as you enjoy these thoughtfully designed outdoor spaces made for both quiet moments and shared time together.Spacious back patio with al fresco dining for 6, gas grill and cozy lounge seating overlooking the Lagoon PoolPrivate 2nd-floor balcony off the Primary King Suite with relaxing Lagoon Pool views2nd-floor front balcony offering an additional outdoor space for fresh air and quiet moments*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor: Queen Bedroom: Flat-screen TV, ample storage Bunk Room: Built-in Twin-over-Full bunk (sleeps 3) with smart TV Full Bathroom: Single vanity, tiled walk-in shower2nd Floor: Primary Suite: Luxurious King Bed, Private furnished balcony, Sitting area, Smart TV, En-suite with soaking tub, double vanity, and tiled walk-in shower Bunk Room: 2 Twin-over-Twin bunks (sleeps 4), Balcony access, Beanbags for lounging Queen Guest Bedroom: Balcony access, Smart TV, ample storage Shared Full Bathroom: Walk-in shower*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Situated between the renowned Rosemary and Alys Beach, in the popular Seacrest Beach Community, "Emerald Escape" sits behind the large, resort style lagoon pool where you can take a 5 minute walk to the beach! Equipped with 7 beach bikes, it makes exploring the area both easy and enjoyable. Lagoon Pool – A 12,000 sq. ft. paradise featuring a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers. Beach Access – Hop on the seasonal tram for an easy ride to the beach, perfect for your gear. Prefer to walk? It’s just a 5-minute stroll to the emerald Gulf waters. Peddler’s Pavilion – A 2-minute bike ride to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife. Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Enjoy picturesque trails just steps from the house, perfect for exploration and relaxation. Walkable, Bike-Friendly Community – Conveniently stroll to Rosemary Beach (8 minutes walk) or Alys Beach in (12 minutes walk) for a charming coastal experience. South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique feature of this stunning area.*** PET-FRIENDLY *** Pets are not allowed on furniture, beds, or in the pool. Dogs must be crated when left unattended by guests. Non-refundable pet fee: $250 + tax.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently. We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment. This property has 7 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes. LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach. There is an active Ring doorbell camera at the entrance door of the home. Pet-friendly with a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax. There is currently major construction going on behind the home with an unknown completion date.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 67450STRO #: STR-067450
